name: My Wolf is the Sun God
original_name: My Wolf is the Sun God
overview: Sun god Apollo angers Zeus, loses his power, and becomes a dying wolf. To survive, he bites Hecate, triggering an ancient fated-bond contract that shares their life and power. A fallen god and a shattered goddess—reluctant master and servant—struggle through Olympus trials. He regains strength by drinking her blood; she heals with his solar essence. From wolf to wolf-eared youth to human, Apollo evolves as Hecate sacrifices herself to save him. He builds her a sun-wolf pack and storms the underworld. When Hades unleashes the primordial god-king Cronus, Apollo realizes his fall and love for Hecate were all Zeus and the Fates' final move. They are the only answer to Ragnarök.
